channel.title: The Temple News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Temple News (temple-news.com)

item.title: “Mourn the dead, fight like hell for the living”: Temple Hospital unions host vigil for Alex Pretti
item.description: More than 50 gathered outside Temple Hospital to mourn the Intensive Care Unit nurse killed in Minneapolis last week.

item.title: REVIEW: Detroit ‘67 captivates audiences with gripping performances
item.description: Detroit ’67, directed by Amina Robinson, opened on January 30 and received a standing ovation from the crowd.

item.title: Owls hang on against Green Wave
item.description: Temple guard Kaylah Turner surpassed 1,000 career points in the Owls’ 67-65 win against Tulane Saturday night.

item.title: Owls take down Bulls in final seconds
item.description: Temple guard Aiden Tobiason scored a game-high 22 points in its 79-78 win against South Florida Saturday night.

item.title: Temple senior surrenders to federal authorities after Minnesota church protest indictment
item.description: Jerome Richardson, who is to graduate in May with a bachelor’s in political science, was released and now awaits trial for federal charges tied to an ICE protest.

item.title: Temple Union of Resident Assistants, administrators negotiate contract details
item.description: TURA’s requests include fair compensation, a clearer job description and better staffing ratios.

item.title: Temple Rome to offer four-year degrees
item.description: The Rome campus will offer eighteen different four-year undergraduate degrees from five Temple schools starting in the fall.

item.title: February 4: Lacrosse 2026 Begins
item.description: The Playbook is your way to get in the game for all things Temple Athletics. Join the TTN sports editors as they break down the past week in sports with expert analysis and appearances from some of your favorite Temple athletes.

item.title: Temple public safety staffing study calls for dozens of new officer hires
item.description: An independent staffing study released in December found Temple’s Department of Public Safety meets essential needs but lacks capacity for proactive policing.

item.title: Owls look to bounce back with more experience in 2026
item.description: Temple recorded just four wins last season, but is ready to put those shortcomings behind it and find success again.
